name: vagaa-dgx
description: Media production (video, image, music, speech, translation, asset library) and free-first web evidence for Claude Code, over two self-hosted MCP gateways you point the plugin at.

media_mcp_url.title: Media gateway MCP URL
media_mcp_url.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint of your media gateway, ending in /mcp. Example: https://media.example.com/mcp

media_mcp_token.title: Media gateway token
media_mcp_token.description: Bearer token for the media gateway. Stored in your OS keychain, never written to the repository.

nole_mcp_url.title: Web-evidence MCP URL
nole_mcp_url.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint of your web-evidence router. Use the compact surface (/mcp-compact, one tool) unless you want the six-tool surface (/mcp). Example: https://search.example.com/mcp-compact

nole_token.title: Web-evidence token
nole_token.description: Bearer token for the web-evidence router. This is a different secret from the media gateway token. Stored in your OS keychain.
